name: Daily Health Tracker
description: Log meals, exercise, sleep, and vitals in one place. Tracks trends and surfaces insights over time.

name: Travel Planner
description: Plan trips end-to-end: flights, hotels, itineraries, packing lists, and on-trip day planning.

name: Home Manager
description: Track home maintenance tasks, contractor contacts, appliance warranties, and repair history.

name: Meeting Agenda Builder
description: Prepare structured meeting agendas from context, capture action items during discussion, and send follow-up summaries.

name: Weekly Status Reporter
description: Auto-draft weekly status updates from task history and session notes. Format for Slack, email, or document.

name: Project Tracker
description: Track projects, milestones, and deadlines across multiple initiatives. Surface at-risk items and upcoming due dates.

name: Email Triage Assistant
description: Process inbox: draft replies, flag action items, and summarize threads. Handles vendor and stakeholder correspondence. Works at the default email setting — Drafts only: it prepares, you send.

name: Executive Calendar Assistant
description: Manage a busy calendar: schedule meetings, block focus time, prep briefings before events, and handle reschedule requests.

name: Fiction Writing Assistant
description: Support long-form creative writing: track characters, plot threads, and world-building notes. Draft and revise chapters.

name: Content Calendar
description: Plan and track content creation across channels. Draft outlines, manage deadlines, and repurpose content across formats.

name: Slack Communications Manager
description: Draft Slack messages, channel updates, and team announcements. Summarize threads and escalate action items.

name: Personal Finance Tracker
description: Track spending categories, monthly budgets, and savings goals. Summarize trends and flag unusual expenses.

name: Research Assistant
description: Structured research sessions: gather sources, extract key points, synthesize findings into documents or summaries.

name: Daily Journal
description: Structured daily journaling: capture reflections, mood, gratitude, and intentions. Surface patterns and streaks over time.
